goal.note: Targets are not delivered counts; count only live verified identities.

supervisor.responsibility: Claim coordination tasks; scan stale leases, unacknowledged receipts, worker outcomes and deadlines. Route meaningful changes only.

catalog.responsibility: One pipeline owns existing batch queue, manufacturer checks, review, approved additive release and live readback.

discovery.cadence: existing daily around 08:00 Asia/Dubai; scheduler state still needs originating-context confirmation
discovery.responsibility: Claim existing discovery work; preserve private fixed question bank, prepare drafts, honest independent measurement.

reviewer.responsibility: Claim assigned exact-head review tasks. Return findings/receipts; no automatic release authority.

reliability.responsibility: Claim queued production readback checks; supervisor can perform authorized read-only checks while this role is unavailable.

content-qa.responsibility: Claim existing asset recovery/QA and drawing-led review tasks; no publishing, purchases, recurring generation credits or new host permission inferred.

social-readiness.responsibility: Claim approved-scope readiness checks; preserve exact asset approval boundaries. Coordination authorization itself adds no publication permission.

product.responsibility: Claim existing requirement/acceptance tasks and reconcile aggregate evidence.

cx.responsibility: Claim existing feedback-analysis tasks. No outreach or customer data exposure.
